changedBehavior: Global LAN scanning moves to the custom title bar with a network/freshness menu, determinate rounded-border progress, a reduced-motion-aware travelling highlight and conditional scan notices.
expectedAssertions: Every page retains title-bar scan/cancel and network-health actions without the former shared scan header.
The keyboard-accessible network menu retains target selection and freshness and is disabled during manual and scheduled scans.
Rendered low and high border progress retain the measured phase fraction, while the independent highlight travels normally and stays static under reduced motion/high contrast.
Narrow windows and enlarged text preserve accessible names, action hit targets, drag space and caption/Snap behavior.
Completion, cancellation, failure, busy measurement and different-network notices preserve page context, independent errors and keyboard focus.
